<passage n="00" section="Control box; 1. EVENT SUMMARY">
SGW Internal - Controlled                                                             AAR-IDA-23

SGW
After-Action Report and Improvement Plan, Hurricane Idalia (August 2023)
Date: 2023-10-23

1. EVENT SUMMARY

Hurricane Idalia made landfall near Keaton Beach, Florida, on 2023-08-30 and crossed southeast
Georgia and coastal South Carolina as a tropical storm. Incident SGW-INC-23-0019 "IDALIA". EOC
activated 2023-08-29 08:00 EDT; deactivated 2023-09-01 18:00 EDT.

Event Type 4 was held throughout. Peak electric outage was about 61,400 customers (1.4 percent)
at 2023-08-31 02:00 EDT, mostly in the Charleston and Orangeburg districts. Water impacts were
limited to two Georgia pressure zones and one booster station on generator power.
</passage>
<passage n="01" section="2. HOT WASH AND REVIEW; 3. STRENGTHS">
2. HOT WASH AND REVIEW

Hot wash held 2023-09-05 at the EOC. Review meetings 2023-09-19 and 2023-10-03. Facilitator:
Bazemore, Tamsin L. Sources: ICS 214 logs, F-WDS-207 run logs, F-MAL-022 fuel requests,
F-WQC-031.

3. STRENGTHS

a. Mutual-aid request decided at H-72 matched the storm's forward speed.

b. Charleston staging at STG-CHS-ASHLEYFERRY-YARD was clear of tidal flooding.

c. Customer notices for the Georgia advisory went out 1 h 20 min after the decision.
</passage>
